meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能针对 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的 bug 自动做调查,生成含根因、复现步骤、修复建议的 GitHub issue 或 PR,并选好目标仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或处理 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发,尤其是需要源码级根因和修复建议的时候。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 的安装器 bug 开一个 GitHub issue。
say.note: Claude 会调查根因并生成标准 issue。

say.text: 把 Codex CLI 这个报错整理成 PR 发给 openai/codex。
say.note: Claude 会创建带修复的 PR。

say.text: 调查一下这个 LazyCodex 插件报错的根因,并提交 issue。
say.note: Claude 会分析源码并生成证据充分的报告。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can turn your bug report about LazyCodex or Codex into a well-structured GitHub issue or PR: it investigates the root cause, prepares reproduction steps, picks the right repository, and includes fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to report, file, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, a Codex plugin, or the upstream Codex CLI, especially when you need source-backed root cause and fix guidance.

say_en.text: File a GitHub issue for the LazyCodex installer bug.
say_en.note: Claude will investigate the root cause and create a standard issue.

say_en.text: Turn this Codex CLI error into a PR for openai/codex.
say_en.note: Claude will create a PR with the proposed fix.

say_en.text: Investigate the root cause of this LazyCodex plugin error and file an issue.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze source and produce an evidence-backed report.
